summary: Version 1 of the TikZ reconstruction compiled and passed validation and topology checks (edges AB, BC, CD, DA all present). The Critic scored it 0.92, with must_repair=false. It reproduces quadrilateral ABCD with labels A, B, C, D, and right-angle marks at A and C. The only residual issue is a low-severity stroke-weight difference (render about 1.5 px vs. about 2-3 px in the original).
